decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor extends an established sports flooring line at little extra cost, and with no evidence after 2019 its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping open.
This mobile arena floor serves a niche project market where demand is lumpy and only slowly revealed, and keeping it listed costs little, so abandoning it would be premature.
It overlaps with the other mobile arena system, which raises the chance it gets consolidated, but there is no evidence of failure yet, so keeping the option is still justified.
The chevron parquet fits the firm's trend-led residential strategy and was featured on the home page, which signals a committed product rather than an option to abandon.
The squash court finish is a very narrow niche, but it is a low-cost surface variant that complements the sports range, so holding the option costs little.
The oak skirting is a cheap accessory that supports sales of the sports floor systems, so keeping it involves negligible cost.
